8 احتاصت Her (a camel's) vulva was, or became, impervious to the virga, or nervus, of the stallion: you should not say حَاصَتْ. (TA.) And احتاصت رَحِمُهَا دُونَ الفَحْلِ Her (a camel's) vulva was rendered impervious to the virga, or nervus, of the stallion, by her having a ring tied over it, i. e., over her vulva. (L, K, * TA. *) ―
-b2- احتاص (assumed tropical:) He was prudent, and guarded himself. (Sgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
